I read all six requested files at that commit: DIRECTION.md, EGRCR_B1_RESULT.json, EGRCR_B1_SCIENCE_CARD.md, experiment.py, config.py, and run.py.

Assessment

One bounded executable observation is warranted. The strongest surviving discriminator is a strictly staged:

three-agent directed-cycle association-support gate, followed only after it passes by

an information-matched pair-Q oracle versus a deliberately strong ordinary-GAE comparator.

No relay, binding cut, learned estimator, or learned gate belongs in this object.

A directed three-cycle is not merely one possible design. Up to relabeling and reversal, it is the smallest construction that gives every joiner one favorable and one unfavorable waiter while giving every physical identity exactly one favorable and one unfavorable waiter role. It eliminates waiter and joiner marginal effects and leaves only the ordered-pair interaction.

However, a positive result would be uninformative if produced with:

a direct pair-label reward rather than an actual waiter-mediated state transition;

an additive or symmetric identity head that cannot express the cycle;

B1’s frozen zero value baseline as the only GAE comparator;

a small or underfit critic;

a deterministic larger-logit evaluator that maps distinct policies to the same token allocation; or

an oracle that receives an event-level compatibility bit or confirmation outcome.

With those defects excluded, the experiment can answer a real bounded question: does this fixed three-agent host contain both genuine identity-distinct causal support and finite-update policy-improvement headroom not already captured by competent ordinary GAE?

Why B1 cannot answer this question

The repository’s current direction statement is appropriately negative: expressibility and selectivity passed, but utility and allocation improvement were zero.

More importantly, B1’s consequence geometry is not identity-sensitive. Its world transition sets the post-join requirement from opp.kind == "JOINT" versus "SOLO"; older_id does not enter the reward or requirement calculation. Its policy features include the acting agent’s ID, cue, time, lag, and pending state, but no nondegenerate three-agent ordered-pair representation. With exactly two agents, the acting joiner ID trivially identifies the sole other agent, so B1 could not create a within-joiner waiter-identity contrast even in principle.

B1 also used ordinary GAE with λ=0.95, an identically zero frozen value baseline, and no critic learning. That was a legitimate frozen B1 treatment, but it is not a sufficiently strong comparator for deciding whether a newly introduced pair-identity oracle has genuine headroom rather than merely cleaner supervision.

The retained result is decisive for B1 itself:

INTACT-GAE native selectivity was positive but small;

At an individual root, INTACT and GAE had different request probabilities but allocated the fixed tokens identically—114 to JOINT and 14 to SOLO—and therefore had exactly the same packet success and bounded utility. That is precisely the evaluator-saturation failure the new object must avoid.

Finally, the B1 science card already gives the correct interpretation of its own result pattern: INTACT>CUT without INTACT>GAE means the cut was harmful, not that correct binding had demonstrated value over the simpler learner.

Physical directed-cycle mechanism

Give each persistent agent an actual output port and input port on a directed ring:

out(i)=(i+1)mod3,in(j)=j.

Atomic activation is compatible exactly when the waiter’s output feeds the joiner’s input:

w=p(j)=(j−1)mod3.

Thus the favorable edges are

(2,0), (0,1), (1,2),

and the unfavorable edges are

(1,0), (2,1), (0,2).

The implementation should compute post-event service from deployed versions, port occupancy, and route connectivity. It should not directly add reward under an is_compatible_pair condition.

A minimal bounded service law would provide two potential service slots on each post-event task tick:

separate fallback execution preserves one slot;

compatible atomic execution enables two slots;

incompatible atomic execution locks the shared port and enables zero slots through B.

Each slot may independently deliver with one frozen, pair-independent probability such as q=0.8, using common tapes across arms and counterfactual worlds. Reward is normalized delivered service minus equal execution costs. A deterministic expectation version of the same transition law is used only for comparator competence calibration.

This creates a genuine path:

later request→earlier waiter executes now→waiter’s deployed port changes→bounded route service changes.

The third agent’s background contribution, actor calls, and physical ticks remain identical in all worlds.

Competent ordinary GAE

The comparator should be stronger than B1’s zero-baseline GAE:

exact finite-state, pair-aware V
π

the critic state includes the same pair identities and physical port state available in the Markov state, but no action, counterfactual, or future realization;

select λ prospectively from a small fixed set such as {0,0.5,0.95,1} using disjoint calibration roots, then freeze it;

full-batch analytic gradient, no minibatch noise;

no critic learning during confirmation;

one common-ancestor actor update.

An exact-value GAE comparator is intentionally severe. In a deterministic Markov version of the host, GAE with λ=0 should reproduce the exact pair-Q policy-gradient direction. If it does not, the head, critic, transition state, or update is defective.

The mandatory noiseless competence gate is therefore:

all six pair-gradient signs correct;

GAE and oracle gradient cosine at least 0.999;

no material difference in held-out pair-ranking probabilities.

Failure stops the experiment before noisy headroom. It cannot be interpreted as oracle superiority.

Common confirmation update

Use twelve new, predeclared independent roots. A compact adequate batch is sixteen on-policy observations in each of the twelve (w,j,a) cells: six ordered pairs times two actions, or 192 eligible source records per root.

Counter-keyed uniforms provide exactly equal a=0 and a=1 counts at stored p=0.5. All trajectory rows remain in the batch.

The two arms are:

GAE-DP: ordinary GAE with the frozen exact value baseline and selected λ;

Stop conditions and decision map

Stop before headroom if any pair lacks the source-to-waiter first stage, any C
j

Bounded support-only result: association support passes, but oracle and GAE have no allocation or utility difference. Conclusion: the host contains real identity-distinct consequences, but competent ordinary GAE is sufficient at this update and budget. No relay investment.

Generic oracle result: native oracle beats GAE, but the source-localized identity panel reproduces the gap. Conclusion: privileged expected-Q supervision beats sampled GAE on a six-cell identity problem; no evidence that the later-joiner-to-waiter path creates special credit headroom. No relay investment.

Evaluator null: pair probabilities differ but fixed-token allocation and utility do not. Conclusion: proximal expressibility without decision-relevant headroom. Do not alter thresholds or introduce an argmax tie-breaking trick after seeing the result.

Only retained positive: support, GAE competence, native allocation and utility headroom, native excess over the source-localized control, and all geometry/accounting facts pass on the predeclared roots. This would justify considering a later, separately frozen relay experiment. It would not itself establish that any relay can estimate or exploit the pair effect.

Strongest evidence against this recommendation

The strongest objection is mathematical: with an expressive ordered-pair head, a fully observed finite Markov state, an exact pair-aware value function, and deterministic source transition, GAE with λ=0 can equal the expected action-advantage direction. A positive oracle gap then requires stochasticity at or after the source transition, finite sampling, or critic imperfection.

Critic imperfection is not acceptable here because it would manufacture the gap. Finite transition noise is acceptable as a bounded local phenomenon, but it can produce the same oracle advantage in an ordinary contextual bandit. That is why the exact-value comparator, noiseless equivalence gate, and source-localized control are essential—and why a positive result may be difficult to obtain.

A second objection survives even after every gate passes: the fixed directed cycle is still a six-entry persistent-identity lookup. The result would contain no evidence of generalization to unseen identities, changing populations, changing topology, or learned association. The privileged oracle would prove available policy-improvement room, not that a practical credit mechanism can recover it.

Decision relevance and claim ceiling

My bounded investment judgment is:

Retain one staged three-agent support-then-headroom observation, using the directed-cycle host, an explicit asymmetric ordered-pair head, exact-value ordinary GAE, an information-matched prospective pair-Q oracle, an interior fixed-token evaluator, and the source-localized identity control. Stop at the first failed prerequisite. Do not run a relay comparison in this object.

The maximum positive claim would be:

In one prospectively frozen, fixed-population three-agent versioned-handoff microhost, ordered waiter identity caused consequence-distinct later-request effects within an otherwise identical generic pre-action stratum, and a prospective expected-action-value update indexed only by the same visible ordered identities available to ordinary GAE produced greater favorable fixed-token allocation and bounded utility after one finite update than a competent pair-aware ordinary-GAE comparator; the headroom was not reproduced by a source-localized identity-only control.

Even that claim would not establish multiple-update value, a learned estimator, a learned gate, relay success, arbitrary source-to-target credit, variable populations, fixed-k superiority, continuous control, UAV relevance, transfer, deployment, or safety.
